hubFacts.previewNote: Preview half (design-cb P1): on a SHOW_PLACEHOLDER_PREVIEW=true build each unsourced fact is PRESENT on /national-show (one spelling per group) and sits inside a marker: an ancestor with [data-placeholder], or a block whose own text carries the 'To be confirmed' or 'Placeholder' chip. Public stays at 0 hits. The '18 shows' group is now 'Editions held': the v4 pack phrases the figure as '18 / Editions held' and the dev renders it that way, so the marked block must carry 'Editions held' and the figure 18.
